tagline: A quiet house on a cobbled street.

packTitle: The Lantern House: Boutique Hotel Theme (6 Pages)
description: A complete six-page Divi 5 website for a boutique hotel, bed and breakfast, guesthouse or inn, ready to make your own. Home, Rooms, Breakfast and Dining, The Town, About and Contact share one warm, understated identity: deep bottle-green backgrounds, brass accents, ivory type in Cormorant Garamond and thin gilt hairline buttons. Every section is built from proven, validated recipes and a single design language and style kit, so buttons, accordions, forms and type match on every page, on desktop, tablet and phone. A full-bleed street hero, press quotes, a split house story, a scrolling services row, a guest quote, room rates in three tiers, a gallery, breakfast and supper stories, a day timeline, a things-to-do guide, a seasonal accordion, a family story and a contact page with a form are all in place. Names, rates and reviews are sample copy: swap in your own and publish. No lorem ipsum, no broken layouts. One simple commercial license, unlimited client sites.
